entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse HR. Order number is 994-0012-B. Just tell me yes or no, can I return it?
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. I'm pulling up the order now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. I can't use it. I had a medical emergency right after it arrived. I was in the hospital for weeks.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright now.
It is what it is. I had to have unexpected surgery, and my son's overseas deployment got moved up, so he couldn't deal with it for me. I just got home. So, can I return it?
Understood. Thank you for that context. Let me just check the delivery date and our policy. I see it was delivered 31 days ago, on December 15th.
Okay, I've just reviewed our return guidelines. You're well within the 90-day return window, so yes, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Good. That's all I needed to know. What's the next step?

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. Simply pack the VeloBand in its original box, affix the label, and drop it at any shipping center. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a speedy recovery.
